title: Enforce RLS policies on all tables
summary: Review all tables in `drizzle/migrations/` to ensure RLS is enabled and policies use `public.current_org()`. Fix any missing policies.

title: Refactor client queries to rely on RLS
summary: Audit `src/hooks/` (e.g., `use-leads.ts`) and `src/components/` for Supabase queries that manually filter by `org_id`. Remove these filters to rely entirely on RLS.

title: Migrate useEffect data fetching to React Query
summary: Search `src/components/` for `useEffect` blocks performing data fetching. Migrate them to `@tanstack/react-query` hooks to ensure consistent server state management.

title: Verify server-side AI execution
summary: Audit `src/components/agent.tsx` and related files to ensure no AI SDK logic or tool execution happens on the client. Verify all calls route through `src/lib/agent/agent.server.ts`.

title: Enforce utility-first styling
summary: Search for custom `.css` files or inline styles in `src/components/` that violate the utility-first approach. Refactor them to use Tailwind classes and shadcn primitives.
